LESSON: SOUND ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL 3.5 Soil By the end of the sub-strand, • Learners be guided to 1. How do
Topic 3.6: SOUND ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on SOUND ENVIRONMENT. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in SOUND ENVIRONMENT
2. Give Kenyan examples for SOUND ENVIRONMENT
3. Practise SOUND ENVIRONMENT at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SOUND ENVIRONMENT
This lesson teaches SOUND ENVIRONMENT for PP2 ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in SOUND ENVIRONMENT
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for SOUND ENVIRONMENT
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise SOUND ENVIRONMENT at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe SOUND ENVIRONMENT using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about SOUND ENVIRONMENT above.
2. Explain SOUND ENVIRONMENT to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand SOUND ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about SOUND ENVIRONMENT with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is SOUND ENVIRONMENT important for a PP2 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in SOUND ENVIRONMENT
2. Give Kenyan examples for SOUND ENVIRONMENT
3. Practise SOUND ENVIRONMENT at school and at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
